results.snippet: The intersection of rural insecurity and agricultural productivity remains a critical operational risk across parts of Nigeria's North-Central zone. In Niger State's Rafi Local Government Area, the recent abduction of 12 pupils from Madarasatul Nurul Islam while harvesting maize on a teacher's farm illustrates the growing vulnerability of agricultural sites to banditry.
